hints.default: Antigravity asks before edits and commands
hints.acceptEdits: File edits in the project go through, commands still ask
hints.auto: Edits and safe commands go through, irreversible actions ask
hints.plan: Antigravity plans carefully before doing anything
hints.bypassPermissions: Nothing asks except denylisted commands. Only where mistakes are cheap

blocked.trustText: Antigravity will read, edit and run commands in this folder, with this project's Antigravity rules, skills and MCP servers. Trust only folders you know.

loginGate.text: Sign in with your Google account. Antigravity opens the sign-in page; paste the code it shows here. The same sign-in serves agy in your terminal.
loginGate.finish: Paste the code from the page below - this screen closes by itself.
loginGate.noTerminal: The sign-in didn't go through. Try again.

notice.quotaExhausted: The Antigravity quota for this model is used up. Pick another model or wait until it resets.
notice.termsBlocked: Google refused this request as a Terms of Service violation. The IDE does not send it again: check your account at https://antigravity.google.
